title: Stage 10 — Final Adversarial Production Audit & Release Certification
summary: Independent adversarial audit. Seven real defects of one class (malformed/stale identifiers and malformed body fields surfacing as HTTP 500 instead of 4xx) were found, minimally fixed, regression-tested (38/38), rebuilt, and live re-verified. Authorization (IDOR across posts/messages/conversations/quests/SSE), concurrency (6-way like/unlike + refresh-replay), rate limiting (429), error handling, and SSE auth all PASS. No reproducible CRITICAL or HIGH defect remains. Held at CONDITIONAL GO solely by four environment blockers: live AI (no GROQ_API_KEY), live object storage (no sidecar), live production DB (no DATABASE_URL), browser E2E (no automation).
